The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Recommends URL path versioning with the version at the front of the URL and an allowed versions list so an unreleased version returns 404
- Keeps a single version until a breaking change is real and keeps the old version running until installed clients move
- Keeps the endpoint as a class-based API with the same error contract

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
